title: Thai Cashew Noodle Salad
description: A refreshing and flavorful Thai-inspired noodle salad, perfect for hot summer days. This dish combines the crunch of cashews, the springiness of noodles, and the tanginess of Vietnamese flavors.
instructions: Cook the rice stick noodles according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a blender or food processor, combine the Vietnamese-Style Dressing ingredients and blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked noodles, cashews, savory spring mix, and chopped cilantro.
Pour the Vietnamese-Style Dressing over the noodle mixture and toss to combine.
Season with sesame oil, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, and honey to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
